json.executive_summary: The baseline ROI is 228.0% with a payback period of 0.44 years, based on an effort reduction of 51.9% and annual savings of $149,065 from 4,259 saved hours. The sensitivity analysis indicates a potential ROI range from -14.0% to 780.0%, with a break-even point at 10 cases per month. It is important to note that all figures derive from prior/implied time estimates; the interview stated no explicit durations or volumes.
